layers.name: Sensing Layer
layers.definition: Observability of model invocations, tool calls, drift signals. Third-party platforms own this layer.
layers.anti_dilution_clause: KYE is NOT an observability platform; KYE CONSUMES sensed events.

layers.name: Capability State Layer
layers.definition: Model evaluations, red-team results, capability monitoring. Specialist evaluation labs own this layer.
layers.anti_dilution_clause: KYE is NOT a model evaluation company; KYE CONSUMES capability profiles.

layers.name: Influence State Layer
layers.definition: Distinguishes rubber-stamp from substantive human review.

layers.name: Machine State Layer
layers.definition: Compute governance and hardware attestation. Hardware vendors own this layer.
layers.anti_dilution_clause: KYE is NOT a compute-governance platform; KYE CONSUMES hardware attestations.

layers.name: Policy Evolution Layer
layers.definition: Governance bodies author and version policy. KYE preserves the version graph.
layers.anti_dilution_clause: KYE is NOT a policy-authoring platform; KYE PRESERVES and VERSIONS policy.

layers.name: Learning / Feedback Layer
layers.definition: Recurring-failure detection. KYE produces the structured feedback signal.
layers.anti_dilution_clause: KYE is NOT a learning platform; KYE PRODUCES recurring-failure feedback.

layers.name: Response / Enforcement Layer
layers.definition: API gateways, payment rails, workflow engines. KYE decides; they enforce.
layers.anti_dilution_clause: KYE is NOT a gateway, payment rail, or workflow engine; KYE DECIDES and the enforcement layer ENFORCES.

layers.name: Appeal / Contestability Layer
layers.definition: Mechanism for affected parties to contest agentic decisions.
layers.anti_dilution_clause: KYE is NOT a dispute-resolution product; KYE PROVIDES the Evidence and Replay substrate.

layers.name: Liability / Accountability Mapping Layer
layers.definition: Legal accountability frameworks; SMCR-style named-person regimes.
layers.anti_dilution_clause: KYE is NOT a legal accountability framework; KYE PROVIDES the named-person evidence substrate.

layers.name: Assurance / Certification Layer
layers.definition: Periodic third-party assurance of operating controls. KYE OWNS via KYE Seal.
layers.anti_dilution_clause: KYE OWNS the Assurance Layer via KYE Seal.

anti_dilution_clauses.text: KYE is NOT an observability platform.
KYE is NOT a model evaluation company.
KYE is NOT a compute-governance platform.
KYE is NOT a GRC tool.
KYE is NOT a dispute resolution system.
KYE is NOT a legal accountability framework.
